name: CodeInput
description: Mortar one-time code field for email or phone verification and two-factor sign-in: one input with autocomplete="one-time-code", shown as a cell per character, that accepts typing, paste and SMS or password-manager autofill.

props.label: string
props.alphanumeric: boolean (letters as well as digits, upper-cased; digits only by default)
props.name: string

contract.usage: Import { CodeInput } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Use it for verification and two-factor codes. It sets inputmode="numeric" (or text when alphanumeric) and autocomplete="one-time-code". onChange receives the cleaned value: pasting "123 456" or "123-456" gives "123456". onComplete fires once the code is full; pass it only when submitting automatically is what you want, otherwise let the person press the submit button. Say where the code was sent in hint, and offer resend and a fallback (recovery code, change email) beside it. See docs/auth-flows.md.
contract.avoid: Do not render one input per digit (it breaks screen readers, paste and autofill), block paste, or log or store codes on the client.
contract.accessibility: One labelled text input carries the value, hint and error; the cells are aria-hidden decoration with a visible focus outline on the active cell. Typing, Backspace, paste and autofill work as in any text field.
